THIS FUNDING IS ON A PARTNERSHIP INTERMEDIARY AGREEMENT. FOR THIS PROJECT ORDER THE OFFICE OF CLEAN ENERGY DEMONSTRATIONS (OCED) WILL PARTNER WITH THE PRIVATE SECTOR TO SUPPORT INVESTMENT IN CLEAN ENERGY DEMONSTRATION PROJECTS ACROSS THE UNITED STATES. IN ITS PROJECT MANAGEMENT OVERSIGHT ROLE, OCED INTENDS TO COLLABORATE EXTENSIVELY WITH COMMUNITIES, INTEGRATING THEIR VOICES INTO DOE DECISION-MAKING AND SUPPORTING THEIR REALIZATION OF A JUST CLEAN ENERGY TRANSITION. A KEY AREA FOR SUCH COLLABORATION IS THE ESTABLISHMENT OF SHARED PRINCIPLES FOR COMMUNITY COLLABORATION THROUGH A PROCESS THAT BRINGS TOGETHER HYPER-LOCAL COMMUNITY STAKEHOLDERS, THE PROJECT AWARDEE, AND OCED. FOR COMMUNITY STAKEHOLDERS TO EFFECTIVELY ENGAGE IN THIS PROCESS, OCED WILL PROVIDE SUPPORT FROM THIS PROJECT FOR LOCAL ORGANIZATIONS THAT CAN CONVENE ALL PARTIES, MANAGE THE LOGISTICS OF THE SHARED PRINCIPLES PROCESS MEETINGS/WORKSHOPS, SUPPORT THE LOCAL PARTICIPANTS THROUGH IMPLEMENTING SOLUTIONS TO HOLD LOCAL COLLABORATIVE MEETINGS/WORKSHOPS, AND SERVE AS A TRUSTED PARTNER TO OCED THROUGHOUT THE PROCESS.
